I made a mistake in that first reply. I added a note that #8841 appears in other material for different issues. That came from knowledge-base results covering channels you can't see, so I shouldn't have included it. I posted a correction right after saying so. The ticket number is still unconfirmed, so check it with Gideon before it goes in the QBR deck.
